title: Union Public Service Commission announces Recruitment Results for the month of July, 2026
body_text:
The following Recruitment cases have been finalised by the Union Public Service Commission during the month of July, 2026 . The recommended candidates have been informed individually by post. Applications of other candidates were duly considered but regretted that it has not been possible to call them for interview/ recommend them for the post.
